insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Analyze your investment performance and market trends

shared.noDataDefault: No data available for this block.
shared.noDataDescription: This insight will appear when enough portfolio data is available.

volatility.title: Volatility
volatility.description: Measures how much portfolio returns fluctuate over the selected period.
volatility.formula: annualized volatility is the standard deviation of daily returns scaled to a year; downside deviation uses only negative returns.

correlation.title: Beta & Correlation
correlation.description: Compares portfolio behavior with the selected benchmark.
correlation.formula: beta estimates sensitivity to benchmark moves; correlation ranges from -1 to +1 based on aligned return series.

var.title: Value at Risk
var.description: Estimates downside loss thresholds from the selected-period return distribution.
var.formula: VaR is the loss threshold at a confidence level; CVaR is the average loss beyond that threshold.

drawdown.title: Drawdown
drawdown.description: Shows peak-to-trough losses and tail-event frequency for the selected period.
drawdown.formula: maximum drawdown is the largest percentage decline from a prior high to a later low.

scenario.title: Scenario Analysis
scenario.description: Applies predefined market scenarios to current exposure weights.
scenario.formula: estimated impact = exposure weight x scenario shock, summed across matched groups.

stress.title: Stress Testing
stress.description: Highlights severe current-exposure shocks that would have a large portfolio impact.
stress.formula: impact value = current exposed market value x stress shock percentage.
stress.empty: No stress test results are available.

portfolioMove.title: Why Does My Portfolio Move?
portfolioMove.description: Shows which current holdings explain today's portfolio move using the latest available daily change for each asset.
portfolioMove.formula: position market value x daily change %, then summed and divided by total portfolio value.
portfolioMove.empty: Daily change data is not available for the current holdings.

attribution.contributionDescription: Ranks open positions by total unrealized P&L, not by today's move or the selected period.
attribution.contributionFormula: market value minus cost basis for each open position.
attribution.groupDescription: Groups current open positions and shows how much each group contributes to total unrealized return.
attribution.groupFormula: sum unrealized P&L for the group / total portfolio cost basis.

concentration.title: Concentration Metrics
concentration.description: Measures whether portfolio value is concentrated in a few positions.
concentration.formula: effective positions = 1 / Herfindahl index; diversification combines holding count and concentration spread.

marketCap.title: Market Cap Exposure
marketCap.description: Groups holdings by company market-cap bucket when market cap metadata is available. Funds, crypto, and missing market caps are shown separately.
marketCap.formula: sum current market value in each bucket / total portfolio value.

exposure.genericDescription: Shows the current market-value split for this exposure dimension.
exposure.genericFormula: group current market value / total portfolio value.

duplicate.title: Duplicate Exposure
duplicate.description: Flags categories where multiple holdings may be exposed to the same underlying driver.
duplicate.formula: group weight is the sum of current market values for holdings sharing that exposure / total portfolio value.

hiddenConcentration.title: Hidden Concentration
hiddenConcentration.description: Highlights grouped exposure that may be less obvious than looking at individual assets.
hiddenConcentration.formula: sum grouped market value / total portfolio value; only high-weight grouped exposures are shown.
hiddenConcentration.empty: No grouped exposure above the concentration threshold.

themeEvolution.title: Theme Evolution
themeEvolution.description: Shows how top theme exposure changed over time from transactions and cost basis snapshots.
themeEvolution.formula: theme cost basis at each snapshot / total active cost basis at that snapshot.
themeEvolution.empty: Theme history is not available yet.

portfolioDna.title: Portfolio DNA
portfolioDna.description: Summarizes the portfolio's style using current concentration, instrument, geography, currency, theme, and breadth metrics.
portfolioDna.formula: each trait is based on the dominant current exposure, except breadth, which uses effective positions.

performance.totalReturnTooltip: Total return is current portfolio value minus cost basis over the selected period.
performance.annualizedReturnTooltip: Annualized return converts the selected-period return into a yearly rate.
performance.sharpeRatioTooltip: Sharpe ratio compares excess return with volatility. Higher usually means better risk-adjusted performance.
performance.alphaTooltip: Alpha is portfolio return minus benchmark return for the selected period.

vsBenchmarkChart.title: Performance vs Benchmark
vsBenchmarkChart.description: Compares cumulative portfolio performance against the selected benchmark.
vsBenchmarkChart.formula: alpha = portfolio return - benchmark return; correlation compares the shape of both return series.
vsBenchmarkChart.empty: Benchmark history is not available for this period.

statistics.title: Performance Statistics
statistics.description: Summarizes daily performance changes within the selected period.
statistics.formula: best/worst day use day-to-day changes in portfolio performance percentage.

riskSummary.title: Risk Summary
riskSummary.description: Shows volatility and downside metrics calculated from the selected-period return series.
riskSummary.formula: volatility is annualized standard deviation; max drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough decline.

insights.aiInsightsDescription: Reserved for future AI-powered portfolio review, hidden risk detection, diversification gaps, opportunity analysis, and narrative explanations.
